scenarios.expectedResult: Pointer scrub snaps to the closest sample; crosshair distance, elevation, grade, risk, and source match the selected sample.
NEXT 1 MI, NEXT 5 MI, and FULL ROUTE change the visible range without rebuilding unrelated profile data; Auto Follow restores progress focus.
Expand and collapse preserve graph state and surrounding Dashboard state across supported responsive widths.
Source inspection is truthful; Show on Map preserves guidance and return restores the Dashboard selection.
Reduced motion is static and background-tab state suspends unnecessary animation without losing selection.
Quick Terrain and the expanded HUD remain readable and operable in portrait and landscape with source state visible without color.
Supported tablet layout and dynamic text preserve labels, actions, safe areas, and risk meaning without clipping.
Stationary scrubbing works; moving mode enables Auto Follow and restricts precision controls using the canonical motion policy.
Complete, flat, partial, and absent elevation fixtures show measured, partial, or unavailable states without decorative terrain.
Canonical progress and off-route state remain visible; Show on Map and return do not replace active guidance or duplicate pins.
Replacing the active vehicle updates fit source/confidence without regenerating the route profile.
A cache hit remains visible as cached or stale; a miss is unavailable and never presents live animation.
Background and foreground restore route, progress, selection, source state, and motion policy without replaying stale live effects.
Repeated expand/collapse does not leak listeners or retain unbounded memory; bounded render/path counters are captured.
A sustained representative route run records battery observations with Dashboard focus, background, and active-guidance phases identified.
A sustained representative route run records thermal observations without claiming improvement or acceptance.
Quick Terrain and the expanded HUD respect iOS safe areas, portrait/landscape layout, source labels, and accessibility.
Where supported, iPad and dynamic text preserve controls, labels, safe areas, and non-color status meaning.
Gesture arbitration permits stationary scrubbing, moving restrictions use canonical motion state, and permission denial remains truthful.
Complete, flat, partial, and absent elevation fixtures show measured, partial, or unavailable states without inferred side slope.
Canonical progress and off-route state survive map handoff and return; active guidance is unchanged.
Vehicle replacement updates fit only; offline cache hit/miss and stale source states remain explicit.
iOS background and foreground restore state within platform limits without stale animation or selection drift.
Repeated expand/collapse captures bounded counters, scrub response, memory observations, and listener stability.
A sustained representative run records iOS battery observations by operational phase.
A sustained representative run records iOS thermal state observations without inferred performance claims.
Risk sections, progress, stale behavior, side-slope unknown state, map handoff, and Dashboard return remain truthful during closed-field guidance.
Every collected device or field artifact binds to the exact commit, app artifact digest, version, and platform build.
The QA owner separately reviews the complete bound package; collection itself does not create approval.
The safety owner separately reviews truthfulness, driver restrictions, and guidance protection.
The field-operations owner separately reviews closed-field usability and operational limitations.
